fixture_storage.s3_bucket: fixture bucket shared with JuiceFS; separate execution-outputs/v1 namespace

reproduction: cargo test --workspace --locked; set AGENT_COMPUTER_PG_BIN, AGENT_COMPUTER_PG_SHARE and LD_LIBRARY_PATH for a private PostgreSQL installation if needed.
bazel build //... //crates/worker:execution_worker_live_test --lockfile_mode=error; bazel test //... with matching --test_env PostgreSQL paths.

Build a rootfs with crates/sandbox/tests/rootfs.py from the current Bazel sandbox binary, then an OCI archive with crates/kubernetes/tests/startup_image.py. Install real PostgreSQL, SeaweedFS, JuiceFS, K3s, CSI and runsc in an owned disposable root VM and import the exact archive.

Prepare private execution configuration including outputs, separate output_spool and rejected_output_credentials_file. Authorize the committed testing RBAC and start the fixture reaper unit. Run execution_worker_live_test --nocapture with AGENT_COMPUTER_EXECUTION_TEST_CONFIG.

The fixture uses two explicitly authorized principals for eleven Candidates, preserving the existing eight-Candidate limit per principal. Final independent S3 verification uses Python urllib/hashlib/hmac and never reads the local spool.
repaired_validation_setup: Initial Cargo network resolution failed at crates-index TLS; cached locked packages and Bazel repin completed offline. No dependency was removed to bypass validation.
Initial PostgreSQL tests lacked the private binary/share/library paths; configured the existing private PostgreSQL 18 installation. Final 141 database tests pass.

The controller-kill assertion assumed the node and database deadlines coincided within 10 ms. Observed a 38 ms conservative offset. The fixture now polls database expiry for at most five seconds without issuing cancellation or deletion.

A transfer retry attempted to overwrite mode-0555 Bazel artifacts and inadvertently ran the old fixture again. Used a fresh transfer directory and verified installed hashes before the final successful run; earlier runs are not delivery evidence.
Eleven Candidates exceeded the fixture caller limit of eight. Added a separately authorized fixture principal for the three output cases without changing platform capacity policy.

The 30-second collection budget and HTTP timeouts do not cancel blocked filesystem calls or an already-running blocking spool task.
